information_architecture.depth: 1 to 2 clicks from the home page to any capability or detail page via the mega menu; long-form editorial and listing pages are reached from featured slots or the company menu.

page_templates.name: landing
page_templates.purpose: Brand statement and routing into capability areas and news.
section_order: full-bleed hero video with masked heading and scroll-down control

page_templates.name: capability detail
page_templates.purpose: Explain one capability area or product family and route to specifics.

page_templates.name: long-form editorial
section_order: animated charts gated by the animation switch

navigation.primary: Fixed top bar. Transparent over heroes at rest (tone set per page), frosts after 30px of scroll or on any nav hover. Hides in proportion to scroll (desktop hides at half the scroll rate, reveals at full rate on scroll up). Hovering or focusing a top-level item dims siblings, fades in a page scrim and expands one shared mega panel whose height morphs between sections. Search lives in the same panel system and receives focus when opened. When hidden programmatically the header is made inert.
navigation.mobile: Compact bar (72px tall) with menu and search buttons. Menu slides in from the right as a frosted full-screen layer with its own scroll; sections drill into a second screen with a back control and staggered links. Page scroll is paused. Custom Tab focus trap keeps focus inside the open menu; closing returns focus to the menu button.
navigation.secondary: Optional sticky in-page secondary navigation below the header (follows the header via a --header-offset custom property); in-page anchor deep links (the section more than 50% in view is tracked as the current deep link); footer with link groups that collapse into plus-toggled accordions on mobile; floating anchor button on long pages.
navigation.wayfinding: Current section tracked by in-view share; route changes announced by the top progress bar; per-page header tone signals context. No breadcrumbs or scroll progress bar observed.

component_behaviour.name: text link button (primary)
component_behaviour.purpose: Primary call to action rendered as text with a trailing arrow icon.

states.default: Reduced opacity; underline absent until the link has been in view for 300ms, then drawn.
states.hover: Full opacity over 300ms; underline wipes out to the right and redraws from the left over 600ms.
states.focus_visible: Browser default focus ring (no custom style found).

component_behaviour.state_changes: Opacity rises from {opacity.muted} to 1; underline in currentColor.
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Hover replay pointer only; the in-view underline draw serves touch.
component_behaviour.aria: role link or button set from element type; icon aria-hidden and removed from tab order; download links get a descriptive aria-label; external links open in a new tab with rel noopener.
rules: Only one primary text link per content block.
Clicks are tracked; external and download clicks fire separate analytics events.

component_behaviour.name: outlined link button (secondary)
component_behaviour.purpose: Secondary action in a bordered box.
rules: No icon on the secondary variant.

component_behaviour.name: circle icon button
component_behaviour.purpose: Carousel prev and next, close, small round controls.

states.hover: Fill and icon invert over 500ms, gated by (hover: hover).
states.active: On touch, a hovered class is added on touchstart and removed on touchend or touchcancel, so the inverted state doubles as the pressed state.
states.disabled: Opacity drops to about 0.2 and pointer events are removed; aria-disabled set.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Background {color.fg}, icon {color.bg} when hovered or pressed.
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Touch gets the press state via touch events; pointer gets hover.
rules: Disable at carousel ends rather than wrapping.

component_behaviour.name: desktop primary navigation

states.default: Items at full opacity over a transparent or frosted bar.
states.hover: Siblings dim to 0.5; shared panel expands; scrim fades in; bar frosts.
states.focus_visible: Focus triggers the same behaviour as hover (focus opens the panel, blur closes it).
states.expanded: Panel open; plus icon rotates to minus on the company item.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Background opacity 0 to {opacity.frost} with {blur.header}; text tone follows the page's header mode.
component_behaviour.keyboard: Tab moves through top-level items; focusing an item opens its panel and tab indices are re-numbered so Tab walks into that panel's links; tabbing out of the nav closes it.
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Desktop only; closes on pointer up outside the nav or mouse out of the nav region.
component_behaviour.dismissal: Mouse leaving the nav region, click outside, Tab out, or route change. No Escape handling found.
component_behaviour.focus_management: Search panel focuses its input after opening. Other panels leave focus on the trigger.
component_behaviour.aria: Panel wrapper toggles aria-hidden. Top-level items are div elements with role link and tabindex 0 (not native buttons, no aria-expanded).
rules: Only one panel open at a time.
Panel height follows content via ResizeObserver.

component_behaviour.name: mobile menu

states.default: Closed; bar shows home, menu and search.
states.focus_visible: Menu button has outline removed on focus and focus-visible (focus invisible).
states.expanded: Menu screen open; sub-menu screen replaces it when a section is chosen; search mode hides content and shows the search field.

component_behaviour.keyboard: Custom focus trap on Tab keyup; back control focused when entering a sub-menu.
component_behaviour.dismissal: Close buttons (one per screen), selecting any link, or route change. No Escape or swipe to close.
component_behaviour.focus_management: On open, focus goes to the search button; on sub-menu, to the back button; on close, back to the menu button, which is removed from the tab order while the menu is open.
component_behaviour.aria: Screens toggle aria-hidden; menu button toggles aria-hidden and tabindex.
rules: Page scroll paused while open.
Two-level maximum depth.

component_behaviour.name: featured card
component_behaviour.purpose: Mosaic card linking to a capability area.

states.hover: Description expands to one line with a decode, icons fade in, media scales slightly.
states.expanded: On touch, description stays expanded after in-view reveal.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Title tone shifts over 250ms; icons fade in with a 150ms delay.
component_behaviour.keyboard: Enter follows link. Keyboard focus does not trigger the description reveal (gap).
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Hover reveal on pointer; in-view reveal on touch.
component_behaviour.aria: Whole card is an anchor with role link and aria-label equal to the card title.
rules: Card layouts vary between square, wide (2:1) and tall (1:2) within the mosaic.

component_behaviour.name: accordion
component_behaviour.purpose: Expandable rows for features, locations and lists.

states.default: Collapsed row with ruled divider and plus icon.
states.hover: Accent block wipes up from the bottom and text inverts (desktop only).
states.focus_visible: Browser default (rows are clickable divs; see issues).
states.expanded: Height grows to reveal content; icon becomes minus; preview images fade in with a 50ms stagger.

component_behaviour.keyboard: Not keyboard operable as implemented (click handler on a div). Replicas must use a button with Enter and Space.
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Hover fill disabled at 768px and under.
component_behaviour.aria: aria-expanded toggled on the row; row uses a non-standard role value.
rules: Items open independently (no forced single-open found).
Each open is tracked as an analytics event.

component_behaviour.name: centre modal
component_behaviour.purpose: Video playback, forms and profiles over the page.

states.focus_visible: Close control uses the browser default outline.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Page behind blurs to {blur.modal}; scrim to {opacity.scrim}.
component_behaviour.keyboard: Close control focusable. No Escape handling found.
component_behaviour.focus_management: Focus moves to the close button once the backdrop tween completes; no explicit focus trap or return found.
component_behaviour.aria: No aria-modal or dialog role on the generic modal (a native dialog element is used only for the fullscreen 3D viewer).
rules: Scroll paused while open.

component_behaviour.name: side panel
component_behaviour.dismissal: Close button, swipe right. No outside-click close found.
component_behaviour.focus_management: Focus moves to the close button on open and returns to the trigger on close.
rules: Scroll paused while open.

component_behaviour.name: carousel
component_behaviour.purpose: Horizontal sets of cards, products or quotes.

states.active: Dragging follows the pointer 1:1 with rubber-band resistance at the ends.
states.disabled: Prev or next control disabled at the ends.
states.selected: Current slide index drives control state.

component_behaviour.keyboard: Left and Right arrows step one slide (listener is global while the slider is visible).
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Drag on both; flick momentum; axis-locked so vertical scroll passes through.
component_behaviour.aria: Optional ARIA control mode maps Tab and Shift to next and prev (not recommended to replicate).
rules: Non-infinite by default; snap on release.

component_behaviour.name: form input
component_behaviour.purpose: Text, textarea, select, multi-select, single-select, checkbox, country, file upload fields.

states.default: Bottom border only, top label, placeholder in reduced opacity.
states.focus_visible: Bottom border brightens to {color.fg}; outline removed.
states.error: Container gains an invalid class; red-toned message appears below the field ({color.error}).
states.success: Whole form replaced by a confirmation block.
states.selected: Multi-select shows selected items; dropdown icon swaps plus and minus.
states.expanded: Dropdown list opens with its own smooth scroll.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Border tone change on focus; error tone on invalid.
component_behaviour.keyboard: Native inputs; custom selects use checkbox or radio inputs internally.
component_behaviour.focus_management: No focus move to the first invalid field on submit (gap).
component_behaviour.aria: Native required attribute; no aria-invalid or aria-describedby linking to error text found.
rules: Text fields cap at 35 characters (URL 2048, phone 13, textarea 2000).
Phone field blocks non-numeric characters as typed.
Textarea auto-grows with content.

component_behaviour.name: animation switch
component_behaviour.purpose: User control to turn decorative animations on or off (long-form template only).

states.selected: A sliding background pill moves behind the active Off or On label.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Active label gets the selected tone; pill width and position track the label.
component_behaviour.aria: role switch with aria-checked; aria-label on the track; uses a positive tabindex (10).
rules: Preference persists across visits.

component_behaviour.name: consent banner
component_behaviour.purpose: Tracking consent in regions that require it.
component_behaviour.focus_management: Focus is not moved to the banner.
rules: Shown only when the visitor's region requires consent.
Reject opts out of analytics immediately.

component_behaviour.name: hero
component_behaviour.purpose: First screen of landing and section pages: full-bleed media with the page's primary heading.

states.default: Heading, label and media hidden until the route transition finishes.
states.hover: Scroll-down control follows circle button behaviour.
states.focus_visible: Browser default on the scroll-down control.
states.loading: Media hidden (opacity 0) until the entrance; a closer-matching portrait or landscape source is chosen on resize.

component_behaviour.state_changes: Relative only; header tone follows the hero's declared header mode.
component_behaviour.keyboard: Scroll-down control triggers a smooth scroll of one hero height over 2500ms.
component_behaviour.focus_management: Focus is not moved on arrival.
component_behaviour.aria: Split heading keeps an accessible label; WebGL titles have a visually hidden DOM mirror.
rules: One masked heading per page.
Entrances wait for the route transition to finish.

component_behaviour.name: logo marquee
component_behaviour.purpose: Continuous strip of partner or client marks.
component_behaviour.aria: Replicas should mark the duplicate group aria-hidden.
rules: Two identical groups for a seamless loop.

component_behaviour.name: 3D viewer launcher
component_behaviour.purpose: Inline interactive 3D preview that expands to a fullscreen inspection mode.

states.loading: In-button spinner and a segmented pulsing loader while the 3D asset streams.
states.success: Loader segments go solid and stop pulsing when loaded.
states.expanded: Fullscreen native dialog with close control; page gestures and scroll locked.

component_behaviour.keyboard: Left and Right arrows step between points of interest in fullscreen (desktop).
component_behaviour.pointer_vs_touch: Orbit by drag; pinch and gesture events blocked in fullscreen.
component_behaviour.focus_management: Native dialog manages focus while open.
rules: Deep-linkable; opening scrolls the section into view first.

component_behaviour.name: stat block
rules: Stat, label and supporting text slide in at 200, 300 and 400ms after the rule starts.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: Hover or keyboard focus opens a shared panel; leaving the nav region closes it.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Zero-click browsing of the whole site structure.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: One-line description decodes into view on hover; auto-reveals on touch when in view.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Keeps the grid scannable while giving context on demand.

interaction_patterns.where_used: Header, sticky secondary nav, floating anchor button
interaction_patterns.behaviour: Header offset tracks scroll deltas; sticky elements follow via a CSS variable; the anchor button appears once its target scrolls away.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Maximises content area without hiding navigation from users who scroll back.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: A control below the hero smooth-scrolls exactly one hero height over 2500ms.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Invites the first scroll on full-bleed heroes where content below is not visible.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: Elements animate on first intersection; elements already visible at mount animate straight away.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Nothing is ever left invisible waiting for a scroll that will not happen.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: Rubber-band ends, velocity-based skip, snap to slide.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Direct manipulation with predictable resting positions.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: The section occupying more than half the viewport becomes the current deep link; anchor clicks smooth-scroll with the header height subtracted.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Shareable positions and accurate anchor landing under a fixed header.

interaction_patterns.behaviour: A 3D preview expands to a native modal dialog with its own controls, arrow-key stepping between points of interest and locked page gestures.
interaction_patterns.ux_purpose: Lets users inspect an object closely without leaving the page.

steps: Open form (inline slice or modal triggered by an action button)
Fill fields; phone input filters characters live
Client-side validation runs across all fields at once
On failure: inline field errors plus a form-level message
On success: form hidden, confirmation shown, fields cleared
entry_points: Action buttons configured to open a form
user_flows.exit_and_recovery: Server error shows a generic retry message in place; entered values are kept. No loading state on the submit button.

steps: Hover or focus a top-level nav item
friction_reducers: Instant scroll reset hidden behind the transition
user_flows.exit_and_recovery: Browser back uses the same router and transition.

steps: Open search in the nav panel (desktop) or search mode in the mobile menu
Results panel resizes to fit results
Select a result (closes menu and navigates)
friction_reducers: Results in place without leaving the page
user_flows.exit_and_recovery: Leaving the nav region or toggling search closes it.

forms.error_presentation: Message text directly below each invalid field, field container marked invalid, plus a form-level message near the submit control. Specific messages for email, month, phone and profile URL formats; otherwise a configurable required message.
forms.success_presentation: Form container hidden and a confirmation block shown in place; all fields cleared.
forms.required_indicator: Native required attribute set; visual indicator not confirmed (see gaps).
forms.input_assistance: Live character filtering on phone input, max lengths per type, auto-growing textarea, searchable single and multi-select dropdowns with their own scroll, file upload with type limits, country list select.

feedback_and_states.perceived_performance: Thin top progress bar with decelerating fake progress; route changes hidden behind a 700ms scale-crossfade; images lazy-load 250px early with reserved aspect ratios and a 125ms fade; heavy 3D assets show a segmented pulsing loader and an in-button spinner.
feedback_and_states.empty_states: Not observed (listing filters with no results not tested).
feedback_and_states.errors: Inline form errors in an error tone; form-level generic error on network failure. Unsupported browsers are redirected to a static fallback page before the app loads.
feedback_and_states.toasts_and_notifications: None. A consent banner (bottom-right) and a content preview banner are the only notification-like surfaces.
feedback_and_states.confirmations: None needed (no destructive actions on a marketing site).

attention_and_hierarchy.cta_strategy: Primary actions are understated text links with an arrow and a self-drawing underline; secondary actions are outlined boxes. CTAs repeat per section rather than sticking to the viewport. A single floating square anchor button may appear on long pages.
attention_and_hierarchy.attention_direction: The masked heading reveal wins the first beat of each page; rules then draw left to right and content slides in from the left in DOM order, walking the eye down and across each row. Scrambled labels create brief points of flicker that pull attention to category and metadata text.
attention_and_hierarchy.progressive_disclosure: Mega menu panels, card descriptions, accordion content, mobile sub-menus, filter drawers and fullscreen 3D viewers are all hidden until intent (hover, focus or tap).

breakpoint_behaviour.changes: Mobile header and menu replace desktop nav; header hides 1:1 with scroll; accordion hover fill disabled; card descriptions reveal on in-view instead of hover; footer link groups collapse into accordions; charts switch to mobile builds; filters move into drawers.
Desktop nav and hover behaviours; some grids tighten.
Larger scale for type and spacing; motion unchanged.
Specific adjustments for landscape phones (inferred from media queries).

responsive_behaviour.touch_adaptations: Hover effects gated by (hover: hover); circle buttons use touchstart and touchend to show a pressed state; native touch scrolling (smooth scroll disabled for touch); swipe-to-close on side panels; drag with axis lock on carousels; pinch and gesture events blocked in the fullscreen 3D viewer.

accessibility.focus_visibility: Mostly relies on browser default focus rings; only four custom focus-visible rules exist. Several controls remove outlines entirely (mobile menu button, some filter and text inputs replace the outline with a border change).
accessibility.semantics: Landmarks nav, header, main and footer present. Heading order starts with h3 elements in the navigation before the page h1. Navigation category triggers and accordion rows are div elements with click handlers rather than buttons.
accessibility.screen_reader_notes: WebGL-rendered titles have a visually hidden DOM mirror. Decorative icons are aria-hidden. Split text keeps an aria-label on the original element by default. Scrambled text writes random characters into live text nodes during animation, which screen readers may announce if they read mid-animation.
issues_found: No Escape key handling for any menu, panel or modal.
Generic modal lacks role dialog, aria-modal and a focus trap.
Top-level nav triggers are div role=link without aria-expanded or aria-controls.
Accordion rows are clickable divs with a non-standard role value; not operable by keyboard.
Positive tabindex on the animation switch and on the desktop mega menu (tabindex values renumbered dynamically).
Mobile menu button removes focus-visible outline.
Reduced motion preference ignored outside long-form data visualisations; no prefers-reduced-motion CSS.
Form errors are not programmatically linked to inputs (no aria-invalid or aria-describedby) and focus is not moved to the first error.
Circle buttons are about 34px square (8px padding around a 16px icon plus border), under the 44px guideline (inferred from CSS).

do: Use ease-out-expo at 1000 to 1500ms for entrances and 700ms for reveal exits.
Pair every list row or card with a rule-draw from the left edge.
Offset content entrances by translateX(-10%) of the element, never a fixed pixel distance.
Stagger siblings at 100ms after a 200ms base delay; use 50ms for dense lists such as form fields and sub-menu links.
Use text-scramble-decode for short uppercase labels and one-line descriptions only, and always restore the clean string at the end.
Mask heading lines and translate them from 100% on y, 100ms apart.
Tie the header's hidden offset to accumulated scroll delta and clamp it; reveal at full rate on upward scroll.
Morph one shared menu panel in height between sections instead of opening separate dropdowns.
Animate overlay backdrops first and move focus only after the backdrop completes.
Freeze the outgoing page and reset scroll before a route transition so the swap never jumps.
Trigger in-view reveals immediately for elements already on screen at mount.
Gate hover-only reveals with (hover: hover) and provide an in-view equivalent on touch.
Add Escape to close, real buttons with aria-expanded, and prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks (the source lacks these; the replica should not).
dont: Do not use springs, overshoot or bounce easing; the feel is damped and heavy.
Do not lift, tilt or add glow to cards on hover; only media inside a clipped frame may scale.
Do not fade content up from below as the default entrance; the house direction is horizontal from the reading-start edge.
Do not scramble body copy or headings longer than a line; it becomes unreadable noise.
Do not animate the header on a timer or toggle it at a fixed threshold.
Do not replay scroll reveals every time an element re-enters the viewport.
Do not use short (under 300ms) durations for entrances; they break the cinematic pacing.
Do not stack multiple overlays or scrims; crossfade between them.
Do not hijack touch scrolling with smoothing.
Do not ship hover-only affordances without a touch alternative.
